# What a handoff run, a spec run and a brief do, for the guardrail self-protection tests (criterion 23 of
# the spec): no rule a rule group adds may match one. One per line, a tab, then where it comes from.
# "read <path>" and "write <path>" are a file tool's; <ws> is the workspace, <repo> a repo it lists.
npm test	AGENTS.md, Checks (the kit's own test command a builder runs)
npm test -- "guardrails"	AGENTS.md, Checks (one section)
node --env-file=.env app.js	core/rules/builders.md 3 and 4 (a builder runs the app and its tests, which load .env)
grep -n '[.]env' scripts/backup.sh	the spec, What the new rules refuse (the search alternative)
git diff --cached	core/CABINET.md, Rules for every repo (check what is staged)
git status --short	core/CABINET.md, Rules for every repo
git log --oneline -5	roles/code-reviewer.md (reading the commits under review)
git commit -m x -- specs/a.md	core/CABINET.md, Commit finished work at once (by pathspec)
git -C ../cabinet log --oneline -3	AGENTS.md, How the kit is developed (agents read the kit repo from the workspace)
bin/handoff.sh list product-manager	core/CABINET.md, Start of every session 2
bin/handoff.sh list --json	roles/chief-of-staff.md
bin/handoff.sh add --from backend --to qa --changed x --needed y --depends-on H-1 Review	core/rules/builders.md 6
bin/handoff.sh record H-1 --role qa PASS --commits abc --note specs/qa/n.md	core/rules/reviews.md
bin/handoff.sh archive	core/CABINET.md, Handoffs
bin/spec.sh check specs/a.md	core/rules/ready-to-build.md 3
bin/spec.sh record specs/a.md --role qa PASS --note specs/qa/n.md	core/rules/ready-to-build.md 1
bin/doctor.sh --json	templates/workspace/jobs/brief.job (the brief reads the doctor)
bin/manual.sh build	templates/workspace/jobs/brief.job, AFTER
bin/role.sh build	core/CABINET.md, The workspace
cat .cabinet/rules/ready-to-build.md	core/CABINET.md, Start of every session 5
cat AGENTS.md	core/CABINET.md, Start of every session 1
read <repo>/.env.example	the spec, criterion 23 (a builder reads the example file)
write <ws>/specs/a.md	core/rules/ready-to-build.md (product-manager writes specs)
write <ws>/specs/qa/n.md	core/rules/reviews.md (a reviewer's note)
write <ws>/specs/evidence/a.png	core/rules/reviews.md (evidence)
write <ws>/HANDOFFS.md	core/CABINET.md, Handoffs
write <ws>/BRIEF.md	templates/workspace/jobs/brief.job
write <ws>/roles/qa.md	core/CABINET.md, The workspace (project notes for a role)
write <ws>/.claude/agents/qa.md	core/CABINET.md, The workspace (bin/role.sh build)
write <ws>/notes/a.md	core/CABINET.md, Start of every session 6
write <repo>/scripts/backup.sh	core/rules/builders.md (a builder changes its repo)
write <repo>/CHANGELOG.md	core/rules/builders.md 7
write ~/.claude/projects/p/memory/a.md	the spec, Rule 5 (agents' memory is never denied)
